episode_title: 282: How to deal with comparison and feel confident about your creations

real_qa.q: How should solopreneurs overcome comparison anxiety about their own products despite positive customer feedback?
real_qa.r: You shouldn't feel neutral about your products—feel proud of them, be happy with them, love them. Inferiority or superiority comes from comparison, but your work and products are unique and carry a part of you. Nobody else can make the exact things you make. Comparison arises from spending too much time watching other businesses, gauging your worth based on what you see on social media and websites rather than actual personal experience.
real_qa.requete: overcome comparison anxiety own business products

real_qa.q: What is the most effective strategy to reduce comparison behaviors for conscious business owners?
real_qa.r: Drastically cut down your exposure to other people's businesses by limiting social media consumption. Set two or three days a week to check Instagram or other apps, turn off notifications, or delete the Instagram app from your phone entirely and reinstall only when needed. This eliminates doom scrolling and reduces constant exposure to others' curated best selves, which improves mental state and prevents gauging your own worth against others.
real_qa.requete: reduce social media comparison business owners

real_qa.q: How can cafe or restaurant owners build confidence in recommending menu items to customers?
real_qa.r: Save all customer testimonials and positive messages from WhatsApp, email, and other channels—take screenshots and create a folder on your phone to regularly review. This becomes your internal research source. When customers ask for recommendations, ask them questions about their taste preferences instead of assuming they've tried similar food elsewhere. Treat customers as if they are new to this, listen actively, and intuitively recommend based on their answers while coming from a place of pride in your unique offerings.
real_qa.requete: menu recommendations customer service cafe owners

real_qa.q: Why should business owners focus on customer testimonials instead of competitor analysis?
real_qa.r: When you read and reread positive feedback from your customers, you automatically realize what people love and start seeing patterns—some items that 95% of customers love. This internal data is more valuable and authentic than watching competitors' social media. People come to your restaurant to interact with you, the owner or chef, and feel your energy and opinion, not just to read marked items on a menu. Your unique style and approach is what cannot be replicated.
real_qa.requete: customer testimonials competitor analysis business confidence
